comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Arrakis (2-knob). build.py reads THIS file; manifest.json is the 6-knob desktop-preview manifest. Sub-octave depth, sweep rate, drive, and tone are baked in arrakis.c.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_. Grouped under DLY (fewest stock effects = easy to find).
fxid_comment: 0x01D9. Bumped from 453 to reload the audible-on-load Mix default (custom effects read params as 0 until a knob is touched, so the manifest default IS the on-load value; Mix=1 made it silent until you wiggled it).

params.name: Detune
params.comment: params[5]. Beat spread between the two detuned voices.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: params[6]. Dry/wet. Default 45 (not ~0) so the effect is AUDIBLE the moment a patch loads — custom effects read params as 0 until a knob is touched, so this default is the on-load value.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
